name: Four Seasons Hotel Abu Dhabi at Al Maryah Island
positioning: Hotel in a 34-storey glass tower on Al Maryah Island in Abu Dhabi, directly linked to The Galleria
best_for: Travelers who want a base directly linked to The Galleria
Guests who like art-inspired design near Louvre Abu Dhabi
Families looking for a family-friendly Friday brunch

facts.text: Hotel accommodations span the 4th to 13th floors of the building.
The property is located adjacent to the Abu Dhabi Global Market, on Al Maryah Island.
The hotel is directly linked with an interior walkway access to The Galleria.
The hotel is a 30-minute drive from Abu Dhabi International Airport (AUH).
Butcher & Still is an authentic 1920s style Chicago steakhouse.
Cafe Milano offers fine Italian dining.
The Pearl Spa and Wellness Abu Dhabi has 8 suites including 1 couple's suite.
The hotel is a 34-storey glass tower.

highlights.text: More than 2,000 pieces of locally and internationally sourced artwork are displayed throughout the hotel.
The hotel is only a stone's throw away from Louvre Abu Dhabi.
The Deluxe Waterfront Room has expansive views of the Arabian Gulf and the bustling promenade.
Crust is home to the capital's favourite family-friendly Friday brunch.
The spa's therapeutic areas include a hammam.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 1 hour 45-minute drive from Dubai International Airport (DXB).
WhataHotel notes the business district location may feel less culturally immersive.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
